_comment: Passage tallies where the action text and Voteview disagree beyond the tolerance (2 votes in total and the same support band), or where a tally exceeds the chamber's seats, and a person decided which is right. The transform fails on such a case until it is listed here with the evidence; it also fails on a listed case that no longer needs the exception. A disagreement found only through a date-and-bill match (not the clerk's roll number) is reported, not fatal.

exceptions.reason: clerk.house.gov roll 223 (1996-06-10, H.R. 3400): 339 yea, 4 nay. The action text is right; Voteview has 345-4.
The action text's 266-176 totals 442, more than the House's 441 seats; Voteview's 226-176 has the same nay count and is plausible.
